page_title: Best AI Website Builder for Small Business | Free & Easy | Butternut.ai

summary.name: Butternut.ai
summary.one_liner: Butternut.ai is an AI website builder that generates a small business website from a short description of the business, with hosting, SSL, SEO, a blog writer and a chatbot included.
use_cases: Creating a small business website without hiring a freelancer or agency
Launching a simple website for a freelancer or consultant
Publishing a business site with a custom domain and SSL
Writing blog posts for a business website with AI
Adding an AI chatbot to capture leads on a website
Selling products, courses or services from a small website
summary.what_it_does: Butternut.ai asks the user to name their business and describe what they do, then generates a website layout with images and copy. Users can customize colors, add videos, change text and insert pages. Publishing covers domain linking, SSL, hosting and security. The page describes automated SEO (meta tags and sitemaps), a built-in AI blog writer, and a one-click AI chatbot that answers questions and captures leads. Paid plans add payment acceptance through PayPal and Stripe, and Google Analytics integration.
notable: Generates a full website from a one-sentence business description in about 20 seconds, per the page
Free custom domain for the first year on paid plans, with hosting and SSL included
Built-in AI blog writer and one-click AI chatbot trained on user data on the higher tier
Claims 500,000+ websites generated and 200+ industries served
caveats: Publishing and linking a custom domain requires a paid plan; the free tier is for building
Paid plans listed at $20/month (Starter) and $69/month (Pro), with yearly billing saving 25%
The Pro-tier custom AI chatbot and WhatsApp integration are only on the higher plan
Savings comparison table and usage claims are the vendor's own marketing figures
